name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
eligibility: All landholding small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land
Valid Aadhaar-linked active bank account with e-KYC completed
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments.
descriptionHindi: सभी पात्र किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष सहायता तीन समान किस्तों में बैंक खाते में।

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefitAmount: Full sum insured coverage for unseasonal rain, frost, hail & pests
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified Rabi/Kharif crops (Wheat, Chana, Mustard, Potato, Paddy)
Subsidized premium: Only 1.5% for Rabi crops, 2.0% for Kharif crops
Coverage from pre-sowing till post-harvest (up to 14 days)
description: Comprehensive financial safety net against unpreventable natural perils, drought, flood, hailstorm, and pests.
descriptionHindi: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं, कीटों और बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नुकसान पर न्यूनतम 1.5% प्रीमियम में संपूर्ण बीमा सुरक्षा।

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
benefitAmount: Up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on standalone solar pumps
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, and village water committees with agricultural land
Farmer pays only 10% upfront; 30% soft loan available through NABARD
Replaces expensive diesel generator pumping with free solar daylight irrigation
description: Provides standalone DC/AC solar water pumping systems (3 HP to 10 HP) to eliminate diesel pumping costs.
descriptionHindi: डीजल पंपों से मुक्ति पाने के लिए 3 से 10 HP सोलर पंप स्थापना पर 60% तक भारी सरकारी सब्सिडी।

name: KCC (Kisan Credit Card) 4% Interest Facility
benefitAmount: Working capital crop loan up to ₹3 Lakh at effective 4% interest rate
eligibility: All farmers cultivating land, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers
Interest subvention of 3% provided on prompt repayment reducing rate to 4%
Revolving credit limit valid for 5 years with simple annual renewal
description: Institutional credit facility for purchasing quality certified seeds, fertilizers, pesticides and diesel without falling into private moneylender debt.
descriptionHindi: फसल लागत (बीज, खाद, कीटनाशक) के लिए ₹3 लाख तक का ऋण मात्र 4% रियायती ब्याज पर।

name: Soil Health Card Scheme (Mrida Swasthya Card)
benefitAmount: 100% Free laboratory testing of 12 vital soil chemical & micronutrient parameters
eligibility: All farmers cultivating crops across all districts in India
Issued once every 3 years after GPS-coordinated field soil sample collection
Provides exact dosage guidance for N-P-K, Sulphur, and Micronutrients (Zinc, Iron, Boron)
description: Diagnostic report card on soil fertility status providing customized fertilizer recommendations to restore soil organic carbon.
descriptionHindi: खेत की मिट्टी के 12 पोषक तत्वों की मुफ्त सरकारी जांच और संतुलित खाद उपयोग की वैज्ञानिक पर्ची।

name: SMAM Farm Machinery Subsidy
nameHindi: कृषि यंत्रीकरण उप-मिशन (ट्रैक्टर व कृषि उपकरण सब्सिडी)
benefitAmount: 40% to 50% subsidy on Tractors, Rotavators, Happy Seeders & Drones
eligibility: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers receive highest subsidy tier of 50%
Custom Hiring Centers (CHC) eligible for up to 80% project subsidy
Farmer must not have availed machinery subsidy on the same machine within the past 5 years
documents: Quotation / Proforma Invoice from authorized farm equipment dealer
description: Promotes farm mechanization for labor-intensive operations. Enables farmers to purchase tractors, happy seeders, and modern spray drones at deeply discounted rates.
descriptionHindi: ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, कल्टीवेटर, लेजर लैंड लेवलर व कृषि ड्रोन खरीदने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
